name: blackraptor-core
description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. The shared Core pack: cross-cutting agents used by every team — `product-manager` (the end-to-end product owner bridging market demand and the build) and `evidence-auditor` (the adversarial gate for research, analysis, and evidence-based reporting) — plus the `research-integrity` methodology skill. Auto-installed as a dependency of all four packs (Engineering, Executive Council, Marketing, Hardware Engineering); you don't install it directly.
